title: BatchNotebook is deprecated
summary: The maintainer says not to use BatchNotebook, marks it deprecated, and recommends runipy.

constraints: Preserve notebook input and output paths, cell execution order, timeouts, errors, kernel selection, and rendered report artifacts.

steps.title: Replace BatchNotebook
steps.instructions: Move notebook execution to runipy as recommended by the maintainer, or to the maintained notebook execution facility selected by the project, then remove BatchNotebook.

verification.purpose: Run notebook execution, timeout, failure, output, and project tests when defined.
